note: Toddler-friendly holiday outings in North Portland, Portland, Vancouver and the north coast, soonest first. Several dates come from event guides rather than the organizers, so the detail says when to double-check.

events.title: Pittock Mansion: Home for the Holidays
events.detail: The mansion and Gate Lodge decorated for 'Holidays from Around the World'; days and times vary, and advance tickets are recommended.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Wildlife-themed holiday lights. The zoo's page sells Any Night tickets for Nov. 20 to Dec. 31 (closed Nov. 24 to 26 and Dec. 25), says tickets are valid through Jan. 3, 2027, and includes a free TriMet ride. Buy online in advance; go early in the evening with little ones.

events.title: Bridgeport Village Letters to Santa
events.detail: Write letters to Santa at the magical Gingerbread Cottage. Free.

events.title: Santa Photos | An Elf™ Christmas Experience at Vancouver Mall
events.detail: Magical holiday photo experience with Santa.

events.title: Christmas Festival at Redland Family Farm
events.detail: Festival with tractor rides, animal visits, and Santa. $10. 9:30 am - 4:30 pm.

events.title: Mini Movers at Laurelhurst Park!
events.detail: Playful movement class using props and storytelling. $18.

events.title: Letters to Santa
events.detail: Drop off letters at the magical mailbox on the Regal patio. Free.

events.title: Decemberville
events.detail: A festive neighborhood celebration with holiday shopping and community festivities.

events.title: Tofurky Trot
events.detail: A 5k run/walk featuring live music from Boka Marimba. $6 – $35.

events.title: Santa at Bass Pro Shops and Cabela’s
events.detail: Family holiday traditions and Christmas memories with Santa Claus.

events.title: Postpartum Yoga (babies welcome)
events.detail: Yoga for postpartum folks to regain strength; babies are welcome.

events.title: 5k Turkey Trot Northeast Community Center
events.detail: Run, walk or roll this fall harvest season event from 8:00 am to 10:00 am. $25.

events.title: Winter Wonderland drive-through lights
events.detail: Drive-through light show benefiting Sunshine Division, Nov. 27 to Dec. 31. Hours per the official site: 5 to 10 p.m. Monday to Thursday, 4:30 to 11 p.m. Friday to Sunday and Dec. 16 to 25. Easy with a toddler since you stay in the car.

events.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square Tree Lighting
events.detail: Free ceremony lighting the 75-foot Douglas fir, which arrived downtown Nov. 10, per KPTV. A 2026 start time isn't posted yet; last year it ran 5:30 to 6:45 p.m.

events.title: Vancouver Community Tree Lighting
events.where: Esther Short Park and Vancouver Waterfront, Vancouver, WA
events.detail: Free Rotary event, 3 to 7 p.m.: Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by river, a lighted vehicle parade rolls downtown, hot chocolate at the waterfront, and the tree lights at 6:30 p.m.

events.title: Christmas Festival of Lights at The Grotto
events.detail: Quarter-mile paved walk through holiday lights, 5 to 9:30 p.m. nightly, closed Christmas Day. Online admission $17.95 for ages 12 and up; ages 2 and under free.

events.title: Holiday Express steam train
events.where: Oregon Rail Heritage Center (next to OMSI), Portland
events.detail: Holiday steam train rides on select dates Nov. 27 to Dec. 27. Adults (14+) $34, children 3 to 13 $25; arrive 20 minutes early. The foundation's day-by-day schedule wasn't showing in search results, so check dates when booking.

events.title: Seaside Parade of Lights
events.detail: Illuminated floats and holiday music, per Visit the Oregon Coast. The city hasn't posted its own 2026 schedule or start time yet, so confirm before driving out.

events.title: Storytime at Washington County Libraries
events.detail: Various storytimes including Toddler Times and Book Babies. Free.

events.title: Santa at Cedar Hills Crossing
events.detail: Holiday magic with Santa visits starting at 12 PM.

events.title: OMSI On Ice
events.detail: Indoor synthetic ice skating in a winter wonderland setting. $8 – $10.

events.title: Mountainside Christmas Market
events.detail: Local vendor market where kids can play on the farm. Free to attend.

events.title: Topaz Farm Holiday Market and Christmas trees
events.detail: Holiday market with Christmas trees opening Saturday, Nov. 28, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., per a community event listing; the farm hasn't confirmed season hours in search results.

events.title: Curiosity Kids: Design and Discover
events.detail: Hour-long hands-on build-and-test class for ages 3 to 5 and their families, in English and Spanish; same-day museum admission included. OMSI's Discovery Lab schedule lists a Nov. 28 session.

events.title: Kitten cuddles
events.detail: Cuddle kittens and visit a pop-up market from 1:00 to 4:00; $5 minimum donation.
